recipe.title: Eggplant and lentil lasagne
recipe.notes: This is from the "Boob to Food" website, boobtofood.com.

method.s: Lay out sliced eggplant on an oven tray, lightly coat with olive oil, and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, turning once half way through.
Meanwhile, sauté onion, garlic and carrot with a couple of pinches of salt and 2 Tbs olive oil, for about five minutes, stirring regularly.
Add 1/2 C tomatoes and cook down so they begin to caramelise. Add the remaining tomatoes and mix well.
Add herbs and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Add kale and stock or broth, and simmer for a further 10 minutes. Salt to taste.
Allow sauce to cool, then blend with a stick blender.
Combine the ricotta and milk in a small bowl.
Turn the oven up to 200 deg C.
Layer the ingredients in an ovenproof dish: sauce, lentils, eggplant, ricotta - ending with ricotta.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake for 20 minutes uncovered, until golden on top.
